answer: Sure - you started the year at Iron Harbor Barbell Club in January (six months paid up front so you couldn't chicken out), then switched to Aqua Lane Swim & Fitness in May because your left knee had been yelling at you for two months and you wanted something low-impact. By late September the chlorine hair got old, so you moved to Vertigo Climbing Co-op, and in December you let that lapse for Kettle & Mat Studio down the block once the winter commute across town became unbearable - the four-minute walk was the whole selling point. So the pattern wasn't restlessness about training itself: it went injury, then a sensory annoyance, then pure convenience, and each new place actually matched what was bugging you at the time.
